purpose: Define a provider-neutral adapter boundary for observing, mirroring, and eventually applying governed repository effects without making any repository provider a source-identity or lineage authority.
core_invariant: Repository adapters provide bounded transport and repository operations; AXIOM source identity, accepted lineage, and execution authority are determined outside the adapter.
claim_boundary: This contract does not implement a GitHub-independent write path.
This contract does not make an adapter operation executable merely because it is within the adapter capability ceiling.
This contract does not configure or synchronize any mirror.
This contract does not promote a repository capability.
GitHub-specific v1 repository operator behavior remains unchanged in this slice.
